name: Ho Chi Minh City food guide
summary: The southern table is sweeter, herbier, and built around rice plates as much as noodle soups. Com tam is the lunch. Banh xeo is the shared snack.
body: District 1 will feed you at any hour. The memorable plates are often a few streets away from Ben Thanh, in rooms that close after lunch.
Order com tam with a pork chop, a banh xeo to share, and a southern pho if you want to compare it with Hanoi’s.

seoDescription: What to eat in Ho Chi Minh City, from com tam to banh xeo.
